Agent Name: Filmography_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Filmography_Expert failed to include "Nosferatu the Vampyre" (1979) in the initial list of Isabelle Adjani feature films. This film is a feature film starring Adjani, has a runtime of approximately 93 minutes (less than 2 hours), and has a very high IMDB rating (7.5). It is also available on Vudu. By omitting this film from the start, the expert created an incomplete dataset, leading the subsequent agents to incorrectly conclude that "Subway" was the highest-rated film meeting the criteria.
